FN-62GWZ31-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 17
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Ron Bolton
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/10/2025
House Bill 17 as introduced could increase receipts to the State General Fund and county
general funds, by an undetermined amount, depending on the number of violations issued and
the penalties imposed.
